resources.string: Create, manage, and terminate simulated processes.
This module will let you create processes, manage process states (New, Ready, Running, Waiting, Terminated), and visualize the process lifecycle in real time.
Spawn and control threads within a process.
This module will simulate thread creation, thread states, and context switching, helping visualize how threads execute independently within a process.
Explore critical sections, Peterson\'s and Bakery algorithms.

This module will demonstrate classic solutions to the critical-section problem, including Peterson\'s Algorithm and the Bakery Algorithm, and visualize how mutual exclusion is achieved between concurrent threads.
This module will simulate message passing, shared memory, and pipe-based communication between simulated processes.
Visualize FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, and more.
This module will implement and visualize CPU scheduling algorithms including FCFS, SJF, Priority, and Round Robin, with Gantt chart output.
This module will simulate memory allocation strategies, paging, and segmentation, along with page replacement algorithms.
This module will simulate how system calls transition control between user mode and kernel mode during execution.
Learn about the Mini Kernel academic project.

Mini Kernel is an educational simulation of core Operating Systems concepts, built to help visualize process management, concurrency, scheduling, memory management, and system calls in an interactive way. It is intended purely for academic learning and does not modify or interact with the real operating system.
